page.content:
Last of the humans (at first) and Ooo's enthusiastic hero.

How Finn the Human connects

  • Series: Adventure Time (series) — The series is Finn's coming-of-age in Ooo.
  • Faction: Heroes of Ooo — Finn is the hero at the center of the Tree Fort trio.
  • Character: Jake the Dog — Finn and Jake are brothers who adventure together.
  • Item: Enchiridion — Finn seeks and later carries the Enchiridion.

What is Finn the Human?

Finn the Human is the boy with the bear hat who wants to be a hero, grows up across the series, and keeps choosing Jake and the Tree Fort.

Key threads lead to Adventure Time (series), Heroes of Ooo, Jake the Dog and Enchiridion.
